c3.instructions:
Given the diff, should merge be blocked because this review comment reports an actual bug introduced in this pull request?
COMMENT: InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions type at line 29 makes teamId optional for all scopes, but the schema correctly requires teamId only for scope: 'team'. This allows code like {scope: 'team', userId: 1, orgId: 1} to compile without teamId, then fails validation silently at runtime, setting this.options to null and returning no results instead of catching the error at compile time. Should use z.input<typeof insightsBookingServiceOptionsSchema> or a discriminated union type instead.
